newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mixed.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices remained mixed on Friday, capping a week of sluggish activity, dealers said.
Dealers said buyers were backing off due to lower CBOT corn prices as well as harvest pressure.

"There is enough feed bought" but demand is not way off, a dealer said. He noted that, with corn prices on the defensive, mids might follow suit. Users will wait until Monday to buy it cheaper, he said.
Another dealer said he has not seen a lot of forward contracting which ordinarily would have been booked by now.

"They have not booked 90-day positions and historically we would have already done it," he said. "The market is waiting for something and maybe they (buyers) want a little bit more stability." He also pointed to concerns of potential hedge pressure.
One Buffalo dealer said run times continued to slacken a bit in the Northeast but demand had not picked up.
"Supply seems to be pretty adequate even with the mill times down," he said.
